source.title: ENISA Technical Implementation Guidance on Cybersecurity Risk Management Measures (Version 1.0)
source.applicability: NIS2-relevant entities across all sectors requiring implementation of defined security roles, responsibilities, authorities and policy documentation per Article 21 obligations

passages.text: indicate the date of the formal approval by the management bodies of the relevant entities (the 'management bodies').
lay down roles and responsibilities pursuant to point 1.2

The network and information system security policy shall be reviewed and, where appropriate, updated by management bodies at least annually and when significant incidents or significant changes to operations or risks occur.
